Hi Karthik / team,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. As discussed, we're ready to move from pilot to a staged rollout of quality monitoring for our customer-facing assistant. Key asks from Helix:

- Install our initial prompt set (attached) and wire it into Redwood's eval harness. We'll want model responses recorded for the eval runs.
- Define regression tripwires and an alerting cadence (email + PagerDuty).
- A canary plan for traffic ramp with automatic rollback thresholds if quality drops > 6% on the intent accuracy metric.

Attached: helix_promptset_v1.csv (labels + expected intent), canary_thresholds.xlsx (proposed metrics).

Can you confirm next steps and a proposed timeline? We have a product release on Nov 6 and would like monitoring live two weeks prior.

Thanks,
Anya

Hi Anya — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments. Short answer: yes, we can meet the timeline if we start this week. Proposed plan: 

1) This week (Oct 21–25): onboarding runbook + initial eval harness mapping. Marissa will own the harness integration, Monica will own prompt set ingestion and label mapping.
2) Next week (Oct 28–Nov 1): run smoke evals against staged traffic, tune thresholds, and run a single canary wave (10% traffic).
3) Nov 4–5: final canary (50% traffic) with rollback gates; Nov 6: full ramp if gates pass.

Canary rollback criteria (proposal):
- Intent accuracy drops >= 6 percentage points vs baseline for 5-minute contiguous window OR
- Top-1 hallucination rate increases > 3 percentage points OR
- Any PII leakage alert fired.

I'll loop in Jordan for operational runbook and PagerDuty routing. Marissa / Monica — can you confirm you have capacity for the tasks and confirm the eval-harness mapping (schema) by EOD Wednesday?

Karthik
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Deliverables by Wed EOD:
- marissa/transform/helix_promptset_transformed.csv (for the harness)
- eval_config.yaml (mapping + thresholds for 1m/5m windows)

Marissa / team — I provisioned the canary route (canary-helix-v1) and a PagerDuty service: Helix-QMON-Alerting. Notes: 

- Canary routing: 10% for wave 1 (smoke), 50% for wave 2. Canary has a fixed baseline snapshot (v2029-10-20) to compare against.
- Automated rollback action created: if any of the gating rules fire, traffic is cut to stable-2029-10-18 and a runbook incident is created. The rollback is automatic but requires a manual follow-up to re-open traffic.
- PD escalation policy: page on critical signals (PII/safety); on metric drift page on on-call SRE + CS on-call.

Anya — I'll need the Helix contact for PagerDuty escalation (phone + escalation policy); if you prefer Slack, I can add a Slack bridge to the alerting channel.
